hero.eyebrow_zh: 山东德宇  ·  真人发制品工厂
hero.title_en: A human hair factory you can build your brand on.
hero.title_zh: 可以托付品牌的真人发工厂
hero.body_en: From raw hair sourcing to finished wigs, closures and extensions - produced under one roof in Shandong, China, and supplied to distributors, salons and hair brands worldwide.
hero.body_zh: 从原料采集到头套、发块、接发成品，全部在中国山东自有车间完成，长期为全球经销商、沙龙与发制品品牌供货。

items.label_zh: 真人发 · 毛鳞片完整

intro.title_en: We make the hair. We do not resell it.
intro.title_zh: 自己生产，不做转手贸易
intro.body_en: Deyu is a manufacturer, not a trading company. Raw hair is bought, sorted, cleaned, wefted and finished by our own team in Juancheng, Shandong - one of China's longest-established human hair producing regions. That control is why our specifications stay consistent from the first sample to the tenth reorder.
intro.body_zh: 德宇是生产型工厂，不是贸易商。原料采购、分拣、清洗、缝帘到成品整理，均由山东鄄城自有团队完成——这里是中国最成熟的真人发产区之一。正因为全流程自控，从首次打样到第十次返单，规格始终一致。

categories.title_zh: 六大系列，出自同一车间
categories.body_en: Choose a collection to browse the full range. Every item is made with 100% human hair.
categories.body_zh: 选择系列浏览完整产品目录，全部产品采用 100% 真人发。

advantages.title_en: Made properly, from the first strand.
advantages.title_zh: 从第一缕发丝开始，就把事情做对
advantages.body_en: Four things we refuse to compromise on, because our customers have to put their own name on the product.
advantages.body_zh: 四件我们不肯将就的事，因为客户会把自己的品牌印在产品上。

items.text_en: We buy and grade raw hair ourselves, so origin, cuticle direction and length ratio are known before production starts.
items.text_zh: 自行采购并分级原料，投产前即明确发源、毛鳞片方向与长度配比。

items.text_en: Sorting, wefting, ventilating and finishing all happen in-house, on the same production lines.
items.text_zh: 分拣、缝帘、钩织与后整均在自有车间同一条产线完成。

items.text_en: Texture, grams, density and shade are recorded per batch, so a reorder matches the sample you approved.
items.text_zh: 每批次记录纹理、克重、密度与色号，返单与确认样保持一致。

items.text_en: Custom lengths, colours, lace types, packaging and labelling for brands and distributors.
items.text_zh: 可为品牌与经销商定制长度、色号、网底、包装与标签。

process.title_en: From raw hair to finished piece
process.body_en: Six stages, all under our own roof. The same process is shown on our Factory page.
process.body_zh: 六道工序，全部在厂内完成。工厂页展示的是同一套流程。

items.text_en: Raw hair is sourced by origin and purchased in single-direction bundles.
items.text_zh: 按发源采购原发，保证单方向顺发成束。

items.text_en: Length, thickness and cuticle condition are graded by hand before any processing.
items.text_zh: 人工按长度、粗细与毛鳞片状态分级后，再进入加工环节。

items.text_en: Gentle cleaning removes impurities while keeping the cuticle intact.
items.text_zh: 温和清洗去除杂质，同时保留完整毛鳞片。

items.text_en: Wefts, closures and wigs are constructed by experienced hands on our own lines.
items.text_zh: 发帘、发块与头套由熟练技工在自有产线制作。

items.text_en: Each piece is checked for shedding, tangling, texture hold and net weight.
items.text_zh: 逐件检查掉发、打结、卷度保持度与净重。

items.text_en: Neutral or private-label packing, then shipped to your nominated forwarder.
items.text_zh: 中性包装或贴牌包装，按指定货代发运。

materials.body_en: We work with three well-established hair origins. Each has its own character, and all are graded to the same in-house specification.
materials.body_zh: 我们长期使用三类成熟发源，各自特点不同，但均按厂内同一标准分级。

items.text_en: Naturally full with a soft wave and a strong strand. A favourite for voluminous textures and curly patterns.
items.text_zh: 发量丰盈、带自然柔波、发丝强韧，适合蓬松纹理与卷度产品。

items.text_en: Fine, silky and close to East Asian hair types; takes colour evenly and stays light on the head.
items.text_zh: 发丝细软顺滑，贴近东亚发质，上色均匀、佩戴轻盈。

items.text_en: Thick, straight and durable with a healthy lustre; ideal for bone straight and double-drawn wefts.
items.text_zh: 粗壮直顺、耐用有光泽，适合骨直与双抽发帘。

factory_teaser.title_en: See where the work actually happens.
factory_teaser.title_zh: 看看产品是在哪里做出来的
factory_teaser.body_en: Sorting tables, wefting lines, lace ventilating benches and the QC room - we would rather show you the workshop than describe it.
factory_teaser.body_zh: 分拣台、缝帘线、钩织工位与质检室——与其描述，不如直接带你看车间。

cta_band.title_en: Looking for a manufacturing partner you can rely on?
cta_band.title_zh: 想找一个长期可靠的工厂伙伴？
cta_band.body_en: Reach the factory team directly by email or WhatsApp. No forms, no checkout - just a straightforward conversation about your specifications.
cta_band.body_zh: 通过邮箱或 WhatsApp 直接联系工厂团队。没有表单、没有下单入口，只谈规格与合作细节。

products_hub.body_en: Six product families, all made in our Shandong workshop with 100% human hair. Select a collection to view the full catalogue.
products_hub.body_zh: 六大产品系列，均产自山东自有车间，采用 100% 真人发。请选择系列查看完整目录。

hero.body_en: A look at the people, the lines and the checks behind every piece we ship.
hero.body_zh: 每一件出货产品背后的人、产线与检验环节，都在这里。

factory.profile_en:
Shandong Deyu Hair Products Factory is located in Juancheng County, Heze, a region with decades of human hair craftsmanship. Our workshop brings raw hair sorting, cleaning, wefting, lace ventilating, finishing and quality control together in one place.

Keeping every stage in-house is a deliberate choice. It lets us record the origin and grade of each batch, hold texture and colour consistent across reorders, and solve a specification question on the production floor instead of over a long email chain.
factory.profile_zh:
山东德宇发制品厂位于菏泽市鄄城县，这里拥有数十年的真人发加工传统。我们的车间把原料分拣、清洗、缝帘、蕾丝钩织、后整与质检集中在同一厂区完成。

全流程自有是刻意的选择：每批原料的发源与等级可追溯，纹理和色号在返单时保持一致，规格问题能在产线上当场解决，而不必来回发邮件确认。

environment.title_en: A clean, orderly place to make hair
environment.body_en: Good hair starts with a controlled workspace: separated raw material storage, dedicated washing and drying areas, and well-lit benches for sorting and ventilation.
environment.body_zh: 好发丝始于可控的现场：原料分区存放、独立洗护晾晒区，以及光线充足的分拣与钩织工位。

workshop.body_en: Unstaged photographs from the production floor. Replace these placeholders with your own workshop shots in the CMS at any time.
workshop.body_zh: 来自产线的真实记录。您可随时在后台上传车间实拍照片替换以下占位图。

quality.body_en: A finished piece is only released after it passes the same checks, batch after batch.
quality.body_zh: 每批成品都通过同一套检验后才可放行。

items.text_en: Comb-through and wash tests to confirm the weft and cuticle direction hold.
items.text_zh: 通过梳理与水洗测试，确认缝线与毛鳞片方向稳定。

items.text_en: Pattern retention after washing, and net weight against the recorded specification.
items.text_zh: 洗后卷度保持度，以及净重与记录规格的一致性。

items.text_en: Hairline, lace softness, colour match and overall finish under daylight lamps.
items.text_zh: 在标准光源下检查发际线、蕾丝柔软度、色号匹配与整体做工。

cta_band.title_en: The workshop is open to partners
cta_band.title_zh: 欢迎合作伙伴到厂看货
cta_band.body_en: Factory visits are welcome by appointment. If you are overseas, we can walk you through the production line on a video call.
cta_band.body_zh: 预约后欢迎到厂参观；海外客户可通过视频连线查看产线。

hero.title_en: A Shandong factory with a long memory for hair
hero.title_zh: 一家懂头发的山东工厂
hero.body_en: DY Deyu is the export name of Shandong Deyu Hair Products Factory. We manufacture human hair wigs, lace pieces, extensions and wefts for professional buyers.
hero.body_zh: DY 德宇是山东德宇发制品厂的对外品牌，为专业采购方生产真人发头套、蕾丝补发片、接发与发帘。

about.story_en:
Deyu began as a small workshop sorting and sewing raw human hair for local traders. Over two decades it grew into a full-process factory supplying wig brands, distributors and salon groups in more than forty markets.

What has not changed is the way we work: buy the hair ourselves, keep the cuticle in one direction, record every batch, and finish the product in our own workshop. We are a manufacturing partner, not a catalogue. Most of our business comes from customers who reorder the same specification year after year.

Our product range now covers six collections - wigs, lace closures, lace frontals, extensions, wefts and ponytails - with Burmese, Yunnan and Vietnamese hair as the three main origins.
about.story_zh:
德宇起步于一间替本地商户分拣、缝制原发的小作坊。二十余年间，逐步发展为全流程工厂，为四十多个市场的假发品牌、经销商与沙龙集团供货。

不变的是做事方式：自己采购原发，保持毛鳞片顺向，逐批记录，成品在自有车间完成。我们是生产伙伴，不是一本产品目录。大部分业务来自年复一年返单同一规格的老客户。

如今产品覆盖六大系列——真人发头套、蕾丝发块、蕾丝发套、接发、发帘与马尾，主要使用缅甸发、云南发与越南发三类发源。

items.text_en: Workshop founded in Juancheng, sorting and sewing raw human hair.
items.text_zh: 鄄城作坊成立，从事原发分拣与缝帘。

items.text_en: First direct export orders; weft and bundle production moved in-house.
items.text_zh: 开始直接出口，发帘与发束产线收回厂内。

items.text_en: Lace wig line added with a dedicated ventilating team.
items.text_zh: 增设蕾丝头套产线与专职钩织团队。

items.text_en: HD and transparent lace range developed for the US and European markets.
items.text_zh: 面向欧美市场开发 HD 与透明蕾丝系列。

items.text_en: Workshop expanded; QC separated into an independent checkpoint.
items.text_zh: 车间扩建，质检升级为独立节点。

advantages.title_en: What a factory partner should give you
advantages.title_zh: 工厂伙伴应该提供什么
advantages.body_en: Six practical reasons buyers keep their production with us.
advantages.body_zh: 采购方把生产长期放在德宇的六个实际理由。

items.text_en: You deal with the people who make the product, not a layer of agents.
items.text_zh: 直接对接生产方，不经过层层中间商。

items.text_en: Origin, grade and cuticle direction are recorded against each batch.
items.text_zh: 每批记录发源、等级与毛鳞片方向。

items.text_en: Texture, weight, density and shade are kept to the approved sample.
items.text_zh: 纹理、克重、密度与色号对齐确认样。

items.text_en: Six collections that can be matched and shipped as one programme.
items.text_zh: 六大系列可配套、可合并发运。

items.text_en: Lengths, colours, lace, packaging and private labels built to your brief.
items.text_zh: 长度、色号、网底、包装与贴牌按需定制。

items.text_en: Clear specifications, realistic lead times and no surprises after approval.
items.text_zh: 规格讲清楚，交期说实话，确认后不临时变卦。

values.title_en: Three rules on the workshop wall

items.text_en: If the hair is not right, it does not enter production.
items.text_zh: 发丝不达标，就不进产线。

items.text_en: What you approved is exactly what we make again.
items.text_zh: 确认过的规格，返单一模一样。

items.text_en: If something cannot be done, you hear it early.
items.text_zh: 做不到的，提前讲清楚。

cta_band.title_en: A good partnership starts with a specification
cta_band.title_zh: 好的合作，从一份规格单开始
cta_band.body_en: Send us the collection, texture and length you have in mind. We will tell you plainly what we can make.
cta_band.body_zh: 把系列、纹理与长度发给我们，能做什么、怎么做，我们直说。

hero.body_en: This site is a product showcase. For specifications, samples or cooperation, write to us or send a WhatsApp message - there is no order form, cart or checkout here.
hero.body_zh: 本网站仅作产品展示。如需规格、样品或洽谈合作，请通过邮件或 WhatsApp 联系；站内不设询价表单、购物车与下单入口。

contact.map_note_en: Paste a Google Maps embed URL in the CMS to activate the interactive map. Visitors in mainland China may prefer a static map image instead.
contact.map_note_zh: 在后台填入谷歌地图嵌入链接即可启用交互地图；如主要访客在中国大陆，也可改用静态地图图片。

prepare.title_en: A few details help us answer faster
prepare.title_zh: 提供这些信息，回复会更快

items.text_en: The collection you are looking at and any product codes from the catalogue.
items.text_zh: 感兴趣的系列，以及目录中看到的产品编号。

items.text_en: Texture, length, colour, density and the quantity you have in mind.
items.text_zh: 纹理、长度、颜色、密度与预计数量。

items.text_en: Your market and nominated forwarder, so we can talk about packing and lead time.
items.text_zh: 目标市场与指定货代，便于确认包装与交期。

cta_band.title_en: No forms. Just the factory team.
cta_band.title_zh: 没有表单，只有工厂团队
cta_band.body_en: Email or WhatsApp reaches the people who run the production line. We normally reply within one working day.
cta_band.body_zh: 邮件与 WhatsApp 由负责产线的团队直接接收，通常一个工作日内回复。
